<thought>Using the molecular formula C15H12O3Cl, the DBE can be calculated with the common simplified formula DBE = C - (H/2) + 1 (halogens are often ignored for this quick calculation). Substituting the values: DBE = 15 - (12/2) + 1 = 15 - 6 + 1 = 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
